c74object.name: syncSuite.video.subs
c74object.digest: Utility for rendering text in the SyncSuite video context.
c74object.description: This object is designed as a wrapper around jit.gl.text and works together with the SubSync M4L device.

inlet.digest: Messages controlling the rendered text and its style
inlet.description: Accepts every message described below, as well as any attribute of the underlying jit.gl.text object (e.g. "font", "align", "line_length", "tracking", "slant", "weight"), since syncSuite.video.subs is a thin wrapper and forwards them straight through. This is also the inlet the paired SubSync Max4Live device streams its live text/style updates into, once connected (see "connect").

outlet.digest: The rendered text, as a texture (if enabled)
outlet.description: Outputs the rendered text as a jit_gl_texture once "output_texture 1" has been sent. Empty/unused while output_texture is off (the default).

objarg.name: context
objarg.digest: Name of the syncSuite.video.context to render into
objarg.description: Required. The name of the syncSuite.video.context this text layer draws to, same as sending it a "drawto" message right after creation.

method.name: text
method.description: Renders "string" as the object's text content, replacing whatever was shown before.

method.name: font
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "font" attribute.

method.name: fontsize
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "fontsize" attribute.

method.name: color
method.description: Sets the text's RGBA color, each channel 0.-1. Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "color" attribute.

method.name: align
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "align" attribute.

method.name: line_length
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "line_length" attribute.

method.name: tracking
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "tracking" attribute.

method.name: slant
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "slant" attribute.

method.name: weight
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "weight" attribute.

method.name: position
method.digest: Positions the text in normalized space
method.description: Places the text at the normalized (-1. to 1.) position x, y in the rendering context.

method.name: positionInPixels
method.digest: Positions the text using pixel coordinates
method.description: Places the text at pixel position x, y, with 0, 0 at the top-left corner. Internally converted to a normalized "position" using the "dimComposite" reference dimensions, so it depends on the paired syncSuite.video.context already running and reporting its own size.

method.name: scale
method.digest: Scales the text on both axes
method.description: Sets the text's x and y scale together.

method.name: scaleX
method.description: Sets only the x scale, leaving y unchanged.

method.name: scaleY
method.description: Sets only the y scale, leaving x unchanged.

method.name: rotatexyz
method.digest: Rotates the text around x, y and z
method.description: Sets the text's rotation, in degrees, around each axis.

method.name: drawto
method.description: Changes which syncSuite.video.context this text layer draws into. Same mechanism used by the object's creation argument.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the destination context's draw buffer.

method.name: enable
method.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) the underlying jit.gl.text object.

method.name: capture
method.digest: Captures a frame into the output texture
method.description: Forwarded directly to the underlying jit.gl.text's "capture" attribute/message.

method.name: output_texture
method.description: When enabled (1), the rendered text is captured to a texture and output out the outlet on every frame. When disabled (0, default), the outlet stays unused. Same as the @capture attribute.

method.name: connect
method.description: Sent by, or in reply to, the paired SubSync Max4Live device to (re)establish the UDP link the device uses to stream text/style updates into this object.

attribute.name: dimComposite
attribute.description: Width and height, in pixels, used as the reference size when converting "positionInPixels" coordinates to the object's normalized position space. Default 1920 1080.

c74object.discussion:
syncSuite.video.subs is a thin wrapper around jit.gl.text: besides the messages listed above, it also accepts and forwards jit.gl.text's own attributes and messages directly (e.g. "font", "align", "line_length", "tracking", "slant", "weight" and others not listed here), so consult the jit.gl.text reference for the full underlying vocabulary.
It is designed to be driven live by the companion SubSync Max4Live device: once "connect" has completed the handshake, the device streams "text" and style messages straight into the object's inlet, letting a performer change on-screen text/style from Ableton Live without touching the Max patch.
